items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I might go some place and appear on a gig and I look and there's one of the guys that I know, and they already know my music. John Bunch, Jimmy Andrews who was at Condon's

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

There's Dill Jones, there's Marty Napoleon. Of course I've done a lot of things with Dick Hyman in the background; and at this particular point I might go some place and appear on a gig and I look and there's one of the guys that I know, and they already know my music. John Bunch, Jimmy Andrews who was at Condon's and I feel very comfortable with all of them and I think what happens, if I run into a piano player with whom I haven't worked before, I don't care how good he is, we're going to have problems, you see.

In time -- that depends on how much time you have to work with them and I think I've been fortunate because I don't necessarily have a group of musicians of my own to carry around behind me. I had the good fortunate to work with a lot of the greats. Hank Jones, Ellis Larkin, of course there was nothing wrong with Billy Kyle and Derek Smith --
